events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the scope, team and calendar for the engagement?
agenda: Present the five phases and what each one delivers
Align on team roles and who attends each steering meeting
Confirm the steering meeting dates and the network data needed from week 1

events.label: Check-in: water balance
events.purpose: Review water balance and leakage share
events.decision: Does the water balance need any adjustment before the loss baseline is finalized?
agenda: Present the network water balance and leakage share
Discuss figures that need adjusting before the baseline
Confirm next steps toward the loss baseline

events.label: Diagnostic sign-off
events.purpose: Close the Diagnostic on the loss baseline
events.decision: Does the steering group accept the loss baseline as the basis for the program design?
agenda: Present the loss baseline by district with locations and causes
Review the water balance and leakage share behind it
Decide whether the baseline is the basis for the program design

events.label: Check-in: design basis
events.decision: Do the routine and program targets stand as the basis for the pilot plan?
agenda: Present the leak-detection routine with its steps and roles
Review the loss-reduction program targets and measures
Confirm what the pilot plan builds on in the weeks ahead

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide on program design and pilot start
events.decision: Does the steering group approve the program design and the pilot in two districts?
agenda: Present the pilot plan with district selection and measurement method
Review the routine design and the program targets
Decide on the program design and the pilot in two districts

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Is the pilot ready to go live in the two districts?
agenda: Present the crew training record and readiness check
Review pre-pilot loss levels for the two districts
Confirm the go-live arrangements for the two districts

events.label: Go/no-go on rollout
events.purpose: Decide on rollout from pilot results
events.decision: Do the pilot results in two districts justify rolling the program out to the others?
agenda: Present the pilot results against pre-pilot loss levels
Review the go-live record and operation log for the two districts
Decide whether the program rolls out to the other districts

events.label: Workshop 2: wave readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the first wave
events.decision: Is the rollout ready to go live in the first wave of districts?
agenda: Present the rollout wave plan and training material
Review the order of the waves and what each wave needs
Confirm the conditions for first-wave go-live

events.label: Workshop 3: wave results
events.purpose: Review first-wave results before more waves
events.decision: Should the remaining waves proceed as planned, given the first-wave results?
agenda: Present the first-wave results report from the district rollout
Discuss lessons for training and coaching in later waves
Confirm the plan for the remaining districts

events.label: Rollout completion
events.purpose: Close the rollout on go-live records
events.decision: Is the new routine running in every district, so measurement can start?
agenda: Present the go-live record for each remaining district
Review the crew training and coaching record by wave
Decide whether the routine runs in every district

events.label: Check-in: loss tracking
events.decision: Does the tracker cover both success criteria well enough for the results report?
agenda: Present the loss and routine-use tracker against the baseline
Review loss and adoption figures against the two success criteria
Confirm what the results report needs to cover

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Close the engagement on measured results
events.decision: Does the steering group accept the measured results as the final result?
agenda: Present the results report for the final readout
Review loss and routine use against the baseline
Decide whether the measured results are accepted as final
